leaves.name: separate-proc-clock-view
leaves.tests: Packaging exact-container self-run using native43_clock_probe --serve and native43_boundary_clock.prove
leaves.replaces: Only engine container /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id, if natural client and engine views are equal
leaves.implementation: Packaging may bind a declared alternate UUID fixture read-only at that proc file in the engine CPU container; actual host client remains outside; neither Python clock nor identity readers are patched; real driver status samples CLOCK_MONOTONIC
leaves.equivalence: Recreates distinct LXC/container boot-id views while preserving kernel monotonic clocks and observed zero time-namespace offsets; actual packet must fall within host send/receive bracket. Identities are retained but never compared for equality.
leaves.cannot_prove: Arbitrary machines or nonzero clock offsets. This is a CPU fixture only and must not ship into box runtime mounts.
